# Documentation Templates

Use these templates to scaffold new Waltr docs, then remove comments and any sections that do not add useful guidance. Templates are starting points, not required headings.

| Template | Use For |
| --- | --- |
| [architecture.md](architecture.md) | Layer responsibilities, boundaries, flows, invariants, and unresolved architecture questions. |
| [feature.md](feature.md) | Feature behavior, owning layer, integration points, tests, non-goals, and references. |
| [runbook.md](runbook.md) | Repeatable operational or maintenance workflows with expected outcomes and failure handling. |
| [agents.md](agents.md) | Local `AGENTS.md` files that summarize path indexes, boundaries, dependencies, contracts, and concise hints. |
